title: Reverse Vowels of a String
description: Reverse only the vowels in a given string.
pseudocode:
1. vowels = 'aeiouAEIOU'
2. i = 0, j = s.length - 1
3. while i < j:
4.   if s[i] not in vowels: i++
5.   else if s[j] not in vowels: j--
6.   else: swap(s[i], s[j]); i++; j--

steps.note: Initialize pointers at both ends of the string.
'h' is not a vowel, increment i.
Both 'e' and 'o' are vowels, swap them.
Loop terminates as i is no longer less than j.
